import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import sys
import time
import uuid

ROOT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'scripts/aws'))
from aws_cli import observe

REGION = 'us-east-1'
ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
PREFIX = 'stackd-sns-archive-kms-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
OUTPUT = ROOT / 'testdata/aws/sns/archive_encryption.json'
ENV = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL')}
ENV.update(AWS_REGION=REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=REGION, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='')
DATA = {'account': ACCOUNT, 'region': REGION, 'prefix': PREFIX, 'observations': [], 'receipts': [], 'cleanup': [], 'sources': ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sns/latest/dg/message-archiving-and-replay-topic-owner.html#message-archiving-and-replay-topic-kms'], 'limitations': ['Native timing and caches are bounded observations. Standard SQS destinations avoid FIFO deduplication obscuring replay receipts.', 'The owned KMS key must remain PendingDeletion for the native minimum seven-day window.']}
TOPIC = None
KEY = None
QUEUES = []
SUBSCRIPTIONS = []
STOP = False


def stamp():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec='milliseconds').replace('+00:00', 'Z')


def save():
    DATA['updated'] = stamp()
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(DATA, indent=2) + '\n')


def call(label, service, operation, parameters=None, *, strict=True, cleanup=False):
    result = observe(service, operation, parameters or {}, ENV, paginate=False)
    row = {'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': operation, 'input': parameters or {}, 'result': result, 'observed': stamp()}
    DATA['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append(row)
    save()
    if strict and result['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(label + ': ' + json.dumps(result))
    return result.get('output', {})


def stop(signum, frame):
    global STOP
    STOP = True


signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, stop)
signal.signal(signal.SIGINT, stop)


def policy(service_allowed):
    statements = [{'Sid': 'Owner', 'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'AWS': f'arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT}:root'}, 'Action': 'kms:*', 'Resource': '*'}]
    if service_allowed:
        statements.append({'Sid': 'SNSArchive', 'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'Service': 'sns.amazonaws.com'}, 'Action': ['kms:Decrypt', 'kms:GenerateDataKey'], 'Resource': '*', 'Condition': {'StringEquals': {'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:sns:topicArn': TOPIC}}})
    return json.dumps({'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': statements})


def destination(label, replay=None):
    q = call(label + '-queue', 'sqs', 'create-queue', {'QueueName': PREFIX + '-' + label})['QueueUrl']
    QUEUES.append(q)
    arn = call(label + '-queue-arn', 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q, 'AttributeNames': ['QueueArn']})['Attributes']['QueueArn']
    p = {'Version': '2012-10-17', 'Statement': [{'Effect': 'Allow', 'Principal': {'Service': 'sns.amazonaws.com'}, 'Action': 'sqs:SendMessage', 'Resource': arn, 'Condition': {'ArnEquals': {'aws:SourceArn': TOPIC}}}]}
    call(label + '-queue-policy', 'sqs', 'set-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': q, 'Attributes': {'Policy': json.dumps(p)}})
    params = {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'Protocol': 'sqs', 'Endpoint': arn, 'ReturnSubscriptionArn': True}
    if replay is not None:
        params['Attributes'] = {'ReplayPolicy': json.dumps(replay)}
    sub = call(label + '-subscribe', 'sns', 'subscribe', params)['SubscriptionArn']
    SUBSCRIPTIONS.append(sub)
    return q, sub


def receive(label, queue, subscription, seconds):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
    start = stamp()
    while time.monotonic() < deadline and not STOP:
        out = call(label + '-receive', 'sqs', 'receive-message', {'QueueUrl': queue, 'WaitTimeSeconds': 5, 'MaxNumberOfMessages': 10, 'MessageSystemAttributeNames': ['All'], 'MessageAttributeNames': ['All']})
        for message in out.get('Messages', []):
            retained = {k: v for k, v in message.items() if k != 'ReceiptHandle'}
            DATA['receipts'].append({'label': label, 'observed': stamp(), 'queue': queue, 'message': retained})
            call(label + '-delete-receipt', 'sqs', 'delete-message', {'QueueUrl': queue, 'ReceiptHandle': message['ReceiptHandle']})
        if out.get('Messages'):
            call(label + '-status', 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': subscription})
            return True
        status = call(label + '-status', 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': subscription}).get('Attributes', {})
        if status.get('ReplayStatus', '').lower() == 'failed':
            break
    DATA.setdefault('windows', []).append({'label': label, 'start': start, 'end': stamp(), 'receipt_observed': False})
    save()
    return False


try:
    identity = call('identity', 'sts', 'get-caller-identity')
    if identity.get('Account') != ACCOUNT or identity.get('Arn') != f'arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT}:user/Delegated':
        raise RuntimeError('Unexpected native identity; no resources created')
    TOPIC = call('create-topic', 'sns', 'create-topic', {'Name': PREFIX + '.fifo', 'Attributes': {'FifoTopic': 'true', 'ArchivePolicy': '{"MessageRetentionPeriod":1}'}})['TopicArn']
    KEY = call('create-key', 'kms', 'create-key', {'Description': PREFIX, 'Policy': policy(True), 'Tags': [{'TagKey': 'stackd-probe', 'TagValue': PREFIX}]})['KeyMetadata']['KeyId']
    call('configure-encryption', 'sns', 'set-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'AttributeName': 'KmsMasterKeyId', 'AttributeValue': KEY})
    attrs = call('archive-attributes', 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC})['Attributes']
    start = attrs['BeginningArchiveTime']
    live_q, live_sub = destination('live')
    published = call('publish-encrypted', 'sns', 'publish', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'Message': 'encrypted archive authority receipt', 'MessageGroupId': 'group', 'MessageDeduplicationId': uuid.uuid4().hex})
    DATA['publication'] = published
    live_ok = receive('live', live_q, live_sub, 90)
    DATA['live_receipt_observed'] = live_ok
    replay = {'PointType': 'Timestamp', 'StartingPoint': start}
    print('Archive KMS ready', flush=True)
    baseline_q, baseline_sub = destination('baseline', replay)
    baseline = receive('baseline', baseline_q, baseline_sub, 180)
    DATA['baseline_replay_observed'] = baseline
    if not baseline:
        raise RuntimeError('No positive encrypted archive replay baseline within observation window')
    call('remove-service-authority', 'kms', 'put-key-policy', {'KeyId': KEY, 'PolicyName': 'default', 'Policy': policy(False)})
    removed_at = time.monotonic()
    denied_q, denied_sub = destination('without-service-grant', replay)
    DATA['warm_without_service_grant_receipt'] = receive('without-service-grant', denied_q, denied_sub, 90)
    while time.monotonic() < removed_at + 330 and not STOP:
        time.sleep(2)
    if STOP:
        raise RuntimeError('Stopped before cold authority observation')
    cold_q, cold_sub = destination('cold-without-service-grant', replay)
    DATA['cold_without_service_grant_receipt'] = receive('cold-without-service-grant', cold_q, cold_sub, 120)
    call('restore-service-authority', 'kms', 'put-key-policy', {'KeyId': KEY, 'PolicyName': 'default', 'Policy': policy(True)})
    restored_q, restored_sub = destination('restored', replay)
    DATA['restored_receipt_observed'] = receive('restored', restored_q, restored_sub, 180)
    call('disable-key', 'kms', 'disable-key', {'KeyId': KEY})
    disabled_q, disabled_sub = destination('disabled', replay)
    DATA['disabled_key_receipt_observed'] = receive('disabled', disabled_q, disabled_sub, 90)
    call('enable-key', 'kms', 'enable-key', {'KeyId': KEY})
    enabled_q, enabled_sub = destination('enabled', replay)
    DATA['enabled_key_receipt_observed'] = receive('enabled', enabled_q, enabled_sub, 180)
except Exception as exc:
    DATA['capture_error'] = str(exc)
    print(str(exc), flush=True)
finally:
    for sub in reversed(SUBSCRIPTIONS):
        call('unsubscribe', 'sns', 'unsubscribe', {'SubscriptionArn': sub}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
        call('subscription-absence', 'sns', 'get-subscription-attributes', {'SubscriptionArn': sub}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
    if TOPIC:
        call('disable-archive', 'sns', 'set-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC, 'AttributeName': 'ArchivePolicy', 'AttributeValue': '{}'}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
        call('delete-topic', 'sns', 'delete-topic', {'TopicArn': TOPIC}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
        call('topic-absence', 'sns', 'get-topic-attributes', {'TopicArn': TOPIC}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
    for queue in reversed(QUEUES):
        call('delete-queue', 'sqs', 'delete-queue', {'QueueUrl': queue}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
        call('queue-absence', 'sqs', 'get-queue-attributes', {'QueueUrl': queue, 'AttributeNames': ['QueueArn']}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
    if KEY:
        call('schedule-key-deletion', 'kms', 'schedule-key-deletion', {'KeyId': KEY, 'PendingWindowInDays': 7}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
        call('key-pending-deletion', 'kms', 'describe-key', {'KeyId': KEY}, strict=False, cleanup=True)
    DATA['capture_program'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
    DATA['finished'] = stamp()
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'fixture': str(OUTPUT), 'receipts': len(DATA['receipts']), 'error': DATA.get('capture_error'), 'key': KEY}), flush=True)
